intro: Teaching activities and scientific collaborations with research groups, laboratories and institutions, in Italy and abroad.

partners: National PhD Course in AI for Agrifood and Environment (XXXIX cycle)

units.name: Use and applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in agriculture
activities: Seminar lecturer for students of the national PhD course in AI for Agrifood and Environment.

units.name: Agriculture 4.0
activities: Teaching assignment as an external expert for the PNRR-funded project “STEM with English”.

units.name: Agricultural, Forestry and Biosystems Engineering Lab
activities: Analysis of remote sensing data in GIS environment.
Development and programming of data input-forcing techniques.

units.name: Ecohydraulics Lab
activities: Development, study and installation of sensors on riparian vegetation for bulk drag calculation.
Validation of data using multispectral images acquired via UAV.
3D scanning and reconstruction of riparian plants to study the interaction with water flow.

units.name: C.I.R.AM.
activities: Hyperspectral, multispectral and thermal soil surveys using drones.
Near-surface soil moisture measurements with TDR, capacitive probes and spectroscopic analysis.

units.name: Hydrology Lab
activities: Development and implementation of a sensor network for monitoring water–soil interactions.
Design of integrated systems for monitoring and managing domestic micro-greenhouses.

units.name: CRISP – Soil Science Lab
activities: Design and implementation of the hardware components of a DSS for the remote management of vineyard irrigation, integrating soil sensors in a local network according to the IoT approach.

units.name: Laboratory of Applied Ecology and System Dynamics
activities: Development of a biological-mathematical model of tree growth and its programming in a 3D environment.

units.name: DroneLAB
activities: Precision agriculture UAV sensors and platforms: development, applications and data production/analysis.
Development of sensors and of a tractor-mounted control unit to prevent vehicle rollover.
3D printing: design and manufacturing of experimental prototypes.

units.name: CoffeeLAB
activities: Design and development of food analysis sensors, data collection and processing.

units.name: Agronomy and Crop Sciences Lab
activities: Development and application of deep-learning algorithms for in-field, real-time weed recognition.
Aerial multispectral surveys for the study of crop–weed interactions.

units.name: Forest Ecology and Silviculture Lab
activities: UAV aerial forest surveys.
Hemispherical image analysis.
Study and development of sensors for forest monitoring.

units.name: Agricultural Mechanics and Biomass Lab
activities: Setting up and management of the laboratory for biomass analysis.
Development of sensors for evaluating the calorific value of biomasses and their main characteristics (moisture, ash content, particle size).

units.name: Rural Building and Agro-Forestry Landscape Lab
activities: Study, development and installation of sensors for barns and animal husbandry.
Photogrammetric and topographic surveys and analysis of the acquired data.
Sensor development for field and spatial-scale surveys, photo-interpretation, remote sensing and drone-supported orthophotos.
Computation and interpretation of environmental indices.
Data acquisition, analysis and processing in GIS environment; development of spatial analysis processes.
Creation of a virtual environment as a decision support platform for land use management and planning.

units.name: Livestock and Animal Production Lab
activities: Deployment of sensors for animal welfare tracking in automatic milking systems (AMS).
Study of calf behaviour in relation to the introduction of automatic feeding systems.

units.name: Stazione Zoologica Anton Dohrn
activities: Photogrammetric surveys of the coastal nesting habitat of Caretta caretta and proposals for the advanced management of the beaches affected by the phenomenon.

units.name: Physics Department
activities: Development, installation and study on the use of atmospheric LiDAR to assess the forest microclimate and its interaction with the atmospheric composition.

units.name: Visual Computing Lab, University of Konstanz (DE)
activities: 3D rendering and programming of plants.

units.name: University of Washington, Seattle (USA), Environmental Engineering Lab
activities: Development of sensors and techniques for galvanic corrosion measurement.
Patent proposal for the developed sensor technology.
